originalTitle: AutoZone (AZO) Stock Drops Despite Market Gains: Important Facts to Note
summary: The latest trading day saw AutoZone (AZO) settling at $2, representing a -1.06% change from its previous close.
content:
In the latest close session, AutoZone (AZO) was down 1.06% at $2,934.52. The stock fell short of the S&P 500, which registered a gain of 0.46% for the day. On the other hand, the Dow registered a gain of 0.56%, and the technology-centric Nasdaq increased by 0.45%.

Shares of the auto parts retailer witnessed a loss of 2.05% over the previous month, beating the performance of the Retail-Wholesale sector with its loss of 3.73%, and underperforming the S&P 500's gain of 2%.

The investment community will be closely monitoring the performance of AutoZone in its forthcoming earnings report. The company is scheduled to release its earnings on September 22, 2026. It is anticipated that the company will report an EPS of $54.97, marking a 12.85% rise compared to the same quarter of the previous year. Alongside, our most recent consensus estimate is anticipating revenue of $6.71 billion, indicating a 7.52% upward movement from the same quarter last year.

Regarding the entire year, the Zacks Consensus Estimates forecast earnings of $150.98 per share and revenue of $20.48 billion, indicating changes of +4.22% and +8.13%, respectively, compared to the previous year.

Additionally, investors should keep an eye on any recent revisions to analyst forecasts for AutoZone. Such recent modifications usually signify the changing landscape of near-term business trends. Therefore, positive revisions in estimates convey analysts' confidence in the business performance and profit potential.

Empirical research indicates that these revisions in estimates have a direct correlation with impending stock price performance. To benefit from this, we have developed the Zacks Rank, a proprietary model which takes these estimate changes into account and provides an actionable rating system.

The Zacks Rank system, which varies between #1 (Strong Buy) and #5 (Strong Sell), carries an impressive track record of exceeding expectations, confirmed by external audits, with stocks at #1 delivering an average annual return of +25% since 1988. Over the past month, there's been a 0.08% fall in the Zacks Consensus EPS estimate. At present, AutoZone boasts a Zacks Rank of #4 (Sell).

From a valuation perspective, AutoZone is currently exchanging hands at a Forward P/E ratio of 16.9. This represents a discount compared to its industry average Forward P/E of 17.17.

It's also important to note that AZO currently trades at a PEG ratio of 1.48. The PEG ratio is similar to the widely-used P/E ratio, but this metric also takes the company's expected earnings growth rate into account. Automotive - Retail and Wholesale - Parts stocks are, on average, holding a PEG ratio of 2.18 based on yesterday's closing prices.

The Automotive - Retail and Wholesale - Parts industry is part of the Retail-Wholesale sector. With its current Zacks Industry Rank of 74, this industry ranks in the top 31% of all industries, numbering over 250.

The Zacks Industry Rank gauges the strength of our industry groups by measuring the average Zacks Rank of the individual stocks within the groups. Our research shows that the top 50% rated industries outperform the bottom half by a factor of 2 to 1.

chineseTitle: 尽管市场上涨，AutoZone (AZO) 股票仍下跌：需要注意的重要事实
chineseSummary: 最新交易日 AutoZone (AZO) 收于 2 美元，较前收盘价上涨 -1.06%。
chineseContent:
在最近的收盘交易日中，AutoZone (AZO) 下跌 1.06%，至 2,934.52 美元。该股的表现低于标准普尔 500 指数，后者当天涨幅为 0.46%。另一方面，道指上涨0.56%，以科技股为主的纳斯达克指数上涨0.45%。

这家汽车零部件零售商的股价较上月下跌 2.05%，跑赢零售批发板块 3.73% 的跌幅，跑输标普 500 指数 2% 的涨幅。

投资界将密切关注 AutoZone 即将发布的收益报告的表现。公司定于2026年9月22日发布财报，预计公司每股收益为54.97美元，较上年同季度增长12.85%。此外，我们最近的一致预测是预计收入为 67.1 亿美元，比去年同期增长 7.52%。

就全年而言，Zacks 一致预期每股收益为 150.98 美元，营收为 204.8 亿美元，与上年相比分别变化 +4.22% 和 +8.13%。

此外，投资者应密切关注分析师对 AutoZone 预测的最新修订。最近的此类修改通常意味着近期业务趋势的变化。因此，预测的积极修正传达了分析师对业务业绩和利润潜力的信心。

实证研究表明，这些预测的修正与即将到来的股价表现直接相关。为了从中受益，我们开发了 Zacks Rank，这是一种专有模型，它考虑了这些估计变化并提供了可行的评级系统。

Zacks Rank 系统介于#1（强力买入）和#5（强力卖出）之间，具有超出预期的令人印象深刻的记录，经外部审计证实，自 1988 年以来，排名第一的股票的平均年回报率为 +25%。在过去的一个月里，Zacks 共识 EPS 估计下降了 0.08%。目前，AutoZone 拥有 Zacks 排名第四（销售）。

从估值角度来看，AutoZone 目前的远期市盈率为 16.9。这比行业平均远期市盈率 17.17 有所折扣。

还需要注意的是，AZO 目前的 PEG 比率为 1.48。 PEG比率与广泛使用的市盈率类似，但该指标也考虑了公司的预期盈利增长率。根据昨天的收盘价，汽车 - 零售和批发 - 零部件股票的 PEG 比率平均为 2.18。

汽车 - 零售和批发 - 零部件行业是零售批发行业的一部分。目前该行业的 Zacks 行业排名为 74 位，在所有行业中排名前 31%，数量超过 250 个。

Zacks 行业排名通过衡量行业组内个股的平均 Zacks 排名来衡量我们行业组的实力。我们的研究表明，排名前 50% 的行业的表现比排名后一半的行业高出 2 比 1。
